sample: The tracked file keeps one row in 10 of the 300,043 galaxies of the two clustering catalogues (217,614 NGC, then 82,429 SGC), in catalogue order, with TARGETID, RA, DEC, Z and the dereddened g, r and z fluxes.
meaning: The bright galaxies of DESI Data Release 1 (BGS BRIGHT, volume-limited to absolute r magnitude -21.5, redshift 0.1 to 0.4), each at its comoving distance in the Planck 2018 cosmology: the cosmic web out to 1.6 Gpc across DESI's footprint.

colorByBands.basis: The Legacy Surveys' own color rendering of these bands (legacypipe sdss_rgb, https://github.com/legacysurvey/legacypipe/blob/main/py/legacypipe/survey.py): z to red times 2.2, r to green times 3.4, g to blue times 6.0. The stretch there changes brightness only, so the channel ratios are the color; the brightest channel is drawn full. The fluxes are observed, so the color is the one the galaxy's light arrives with.

toneBy.basis: Presentation of a measured quantity: each galaxy's r magnitude (22.5 - 2.5 log10 flux, the Legacy Surveys' zero point) at its Planck 2018 luminosity distance, full at -23.4 and 40% at -22.5, about the 5th and 95th percentiles of the sample (-23.38 and -22.47). No k-correction is applied, so the values are observed-frame and brighter than DESI's -21.5 selection.
